title: Non-Craftable Recipes - IrdurDev
description: This mod adds recipes for items that cannot be crafted in Minecraft Vanilla.
body:
This mod adds recipes for items that cannot be crafted in **Minecraft Vanilla**.
You can craft saddles, notch apple, Wither roses, sea heart, elytra, etc. All while maintaining the **Vanilla gameplay and recipes**, it is entirely possible in survival mode.

It works on both the server and the client. However, if you install it on your server with friends, they will also need the mod. And it does **not require any dependencies**.
